paragraphs.source_en: "I say only this!" Arkady said, staring at her bug-eyed: "We have come to Mars for good. We are going to make not only our homes and our food, but also our water and the very air we breathe-all on a planet that has none of these things. We can do this because we have technology to manipulate matter right down to the molecular level. This is an extraordinary ability, think of it! And yet some of us here can accept transforming the entire physical reality of this planet, without doing a single thing to change our selves, or the way we live. To be twenty-first century scientists on Mars, in fact, but at the same time living within nineteenth century social systems, based on seventeenth century ideologies. Others were simply disgruntled, but unwilling to cause to much of a fuss at this particular dinner, which was supposed to be a celebration. It was easier to roll one's eyes, and drink to the toast.
